title: Chemotherapeutic efficacy of dihydromyricetin ruthenium-p-cymene complex in lung cancer through modulation of the PI3K/beta-catenin/AhR signaling cascade.
authors: Manna, Priya; Gayen, Sakuntala; Roy, Souvik
one_liner_zh: 该文研究钌配合物在肺癌中的化疗效果及信号通路调控，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Flavonoids have been regarded as a potent bioactive chemical for the past few decades. When flavonoids complexed with metal ions, exceptional organometallic complexes with enhanced pharmacological and therapeutic qualities were formed. The novel dihydromyricetin ruthenium-p-cymene complex has been synthesized and characterized using the use of modern analytical methods like mass spectrometry, FTIR, UV-visible spectroscopy, scanning electron microscopy, and NMR spectroscopy. Molecular docking and pharmacokinetic studies have been carried out. The in vitro study has been executed through cell viability study, colony formation assay, apoptosis assay, cell cycle arrest study, and western blot study in A549 and NCI-H460 cells. The complex's toxicological profile has been evaluated using both acute and subacute toxicity study. The in vivo study has been performed through the administration of benzo[alpha]pyrene in mice, sustained for 6 months, and treated with different doses of the complex, followed by histopathology, immunohistochemistry, ki-67 expression level, and apoptosis assay by the TUNEL method have been performed. As a result, the compound has shown more potent antioxidant activity than free dihydromyricetin. Followed by the treatment with complex, the number and size of colonies have been reduced in association with the initiation of apoptosis. Downstream of AKT, beta-catenin, and AhR expression was evaluated in a western blot study. From the toxicity study, doses of 50, 100, and 200 mg/kg were identified as safe for conducting in vivo chemotherapeutic studies of the novel complex. Treatment with the complex in mice demonstrated significant recovery of the normal cellular architecture in lung tissues. Immunohistochemical analysis revealed that decreased PI3K, m-TOR, beta-catenin, and AhR expression, along with enhanced PTEN expression, correlated with the induction of apoptotic events. Thus, dihydromyricetin ruthenium-p-cymene complex has been proven as a strong chemotherapeutic drug by modifying PI3K/beta-catenin/AhR signalling cascade inside lung cancer microenvironment, thereby causing apoptotic cell death.
abstract_zh: 近几十年来，黄酮类化合物一直被视为一种有效的生物活性化学物质。当黄酮类化合物与金属离子络合时，形成了具有增强药理和治疗特性的特殊有机金属配合物。新型二氢杨梅素钌-对伞花烃配合物已通过质谱、傅里叶变换红外光谱、紫外-可见光谱、扫描电子显微镜和核磁共振波谱等现代分析方法合成并表征。已进行分子对接和药代动力学研究。体外研究通过细胞活力测定、集落形成实验、凋亡实验、细胞周期阻滞研究以及蛋白质印迹研究在A549和NCI-H460细胞中执行。该配合物的毒理学特征已通过急性和亚急性毒性研究评估。体内研究通过在小鼠中施用苯并[alpha]芘进行，持续6个月，并用不同剂量的配合物处理，随后进行组织病理学、免疫组织化学、ki-67表达水平以及通过TUNEL方法进行的凋亡实验。结果显示，该化合物表现出比游离二氢杨梅素更强的抗氧化活性。经配合物处理后，集落数量和大小减少，并伴随凋亡的启动。在蛋白质印迹研究中评估了AKT、β-连环蛋白和AhR的下游表达。从毒性研究中，50、100和200 mg/kg的剂量被确定为安全，可用于该新型配合物的体内化疗研究。小鼠中配合物的处理显示肺组织中正常细胞结构的显著恢复。免疫组织化学分析显示，PI3K、m-TOR、β-连环蛋白和AhR表达降低，同时PTEN表达增强，与凋亡事件的诱导相关。因此，二氢杨梅素钌-对伞花烃配合物通过修饰肺癌微环境中的PI3K/β-连环蛋白/AhR信号级联，从而引起凋亡性细胞死亡，已被证明是一种强效化疗药物。
